nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Moisture Cream

avis.texte: I just wash my face with a cleanswr twice and put this moisturizer on my face and its greatt no toner no nothing just cleanser n this with consistency 🤌🏾

I bought this product in a travel size for vacation, since my typical moisturizer is a full size Tatcha dewy moisturizer. I have now used this product 3 times prior to going on vacation to give it a try before my trip. Every time I have used it, within 5 minutes of putting a generous amount on, I experience tightness and dryness of my face and visibly flaky dry skin. Every time I have used this product I have needed to apply my Tatcha moisturizer on top of it because of how dry it makes me. One of the days I had acne as well and it was very stingy while applying. Overall would never purchase a full size of this product.

This cream was helpful during the cold winter months and kept my skin from drying out especially overnight. It layered well under my serums and left my skin smooth and soft after each use. I would recommend for sensitive skin.
I love this moisturizer. The texture is on the thinner side but it is still very moisturizing. It feels very light and absorbs easily into the skin. I love this product.

Easily one of my favorite lightweight moisturizers! It hydrates really well without feeling greasy or heavy, and it noticeably helps calm redness/irritation compared to other creams I've tried that are either too thick or don't last. It leaves my skin soft, plump, and comfortable all day, layers perfectly under sunscreen/makeup, and doesn't have a strong fragrance which is great for sensitive skin. Overall, I would definitely buy it again and I 100% recommend it to friends or family, especially anyone dealing with dryness, sensitivity, or easily irritated skin

Aging skin and tried this out. I like it and used with the centella blue serum. I have no complaints with this duo. Pairs well under my makeup routine; Brightening primers, powders, bronzer, and blush!

I've used other skin1004 products, but this is my first time trying the Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Moisture cream and I was impressed! Such a nice texture and so hydrating!! My one complaint is that the scent is a little strong, but my sensitive skin hasn't had any issues with it so far.

avis.titre: Great for irritated acne prone skin!
avis.texte: Centella and Hyaluronic acid are my favorite ingredients in skincare and I was excited to see that Skin1004 married these two ingredients! I love how this cream feels on my skin and doesn't irritate it. I use retinol and benzoyl peroxide for my acne which can be irritating so I'm happy to report this is a soothing product and keeps my skin from getting angry. Also I appreciate the simple packaging and that it's in a tube rather than a jar. I received this product as part of a free sample program.

I received this product as part of a free sample program. The Centella Hyalu-Cica Moisture Cream provides excellent hydration and is ideal for the colder months when skin needs extra moisture. I have sensitive skin and was a bit nervous to try it, but it was gentle and worked wonderfully without causing any irritation.

I was in need of a good moisturizer for the winter days and I the Hyalu-Cica moisture cream has been amazing, it really leaves your face feeling hydrated, I also love the milky consistency and the sweet but kind of soft smell. Its a great addition to your skincare routine during this cold and dry season.

avis.titre: Dry acne prone skin girlies, this is it!
avis.texte: I've been using this moisturizer for about a month now and can confirm that it doesn't cause breakouts – my biggest problem when I try new products. As shown in the pictures, no new breakouts occurred overnight, what it usually happens in my case. My overall experience was great and I use it not only overnight, but as a primer for makeup, which helps protecting the skin from developing more breakouts. 10/10, will definitely buy again and recommend to my friends.

avis.titre: As a aesthetician run and get this cream
avis.texte: When I was giving the opportunity to try this cream I was so excited I just knew I would love it, and it do not disappoint I suffer from really dry skin to wear I get dry paying my fae and this cream came and saved my skin very light weight yet heavy enough to penetrate my skin barrier. I love this moisturizer I've found my holy grail…
Best moisturizing cream for my dry skin. It blends in so well. I can't put them in words. Not greasy at all like the others.

I really love SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Moisture Cream. The texture is lightweight but very moisturizing, and it absorbs quickly without feeling greasy. It instantly calms my skin and keeps it hydrated throughout the day. This cream works perfectly for sensitive skin and helps soothe redness while leaving my skin soft and smooth. It feels gentle, clean, and refreshing every time I use it. Overall, it's a great daily moisturizer that delivers both hydration and comfort. I'm very happy with the results and would definitely repurchase.

[I was provided a free sample of the Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Moisture Cream to review by Skin1004 through BzzAgent.] I have used Skin1004 brands and have really liked them before. This cream is no exception! This product was really soothing and almost had a cooling feeling. Texture-wise it has a lot of slip and feels kind of silicone-y(?) like a primer and is neither lightweight nor too heavy. It initially feels a little sticky, but it absorbs fairly well and the feeling goes away quickly. It has a generic fruity scent, but it isn't off-putting or too strong. I really like the scent, actually. This cream also plays very nicely under makeup, has no pilling, and is a good base. Currently my skin is pretty sensitive, and my skin barrier is slightly damaged, but I still felt like my skin was well-moisturized throughout the day. I also used it when I accidentally over-exfoliated, and it felt nice and helped me heal. I recommend this product and would repurchase it with my own money.

avis.titre: Love this! Definitely has become a favorite !
avis.texte: I'm obsessed with Centella asiactica, so when I had the opportunity to try this product out in return for an honest review I was all in and this product has easily become a staple in my routine. The combination of centella with the hyaluronic acid is very nuanced and genius. The amount of moisture I felt when I first applied it, keep in mind, it is not greasy or heavy at all! It was amazing and I highly recommend especially during the winter months which tend to be more drying in the skin. It absorbs nicely and feels very good and pleasant on the skin. Overall excellent product and at this price point, it cannot be beat! Definitely try it! Highly recommend!!

I really wanted to enjoy this product, however I'm unsure if it's just because I live in pretty rough winter conditions but it really didn't do much. It was lightweight, non greasy but it just didn't do a whole lot and I still needed a heavier moisturizer after. I typically have normal to dry skin. I received this product for free in return for a review.

The Hyalu-Cica Moisture Cream is super lightweight yet deeply hydrating. It absorbs quickly without feeling greasy and instantly calms my skin. Perfect for sensitive or irritated skin my face feels soft, plump, and moisturized all day. A little goes a long way, and it layers well under makeup. Definitely a staple in my skincare routine.

When first applying this, it has a wonderfully soothing feel for your face. But for me after a few minutes I felt that it just continued to sit on the surface and never felt like it fully absorbed into my face. My face felt like it "couldn't breathe". I had to wipe off some before applying make up due to it never absorbing fully. So overall, feels refreshing at first but then soon it feels like a layer of cream that makes me break out into an instant sweat due to my face not "breathing". I have very dry skin and was expecting more from this.

I've been using the Centella Hyalu Cica Moisture Cream for a couple of weeks now and my skin is feeling and looking better than ever. It is super lightweight and doesn't leave my skin sticky. Leaves my skin feeling super hydrated and ready for my makeup application. The price is unbelievable.

I received this product in exchange for an honest review. This moisturizer has been pretty good for my dry skin. I don't think it's as moisturizing as others that I have used, but it gets the job done for sure. It's light enough to be worn during the daytime, under makeup but not so light that it doesn't do anything for my skin. There is no scent and it doesn't irritate my skin at all. This is a good all purpose moisturizer but I do prefer something a bit more rich for night time use, but that's just me because my skin is so dry.
I liked its texture, neither too light nor too heavy for the skin. It keeps the skin hydrated all day long.

I have combination skin with oily spots near the bridge of my nose but its mostly dry everywhere else and I typically use Lubriderm for my face. However, the Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Moisture Cream was great! It melts into your skin and doesn't leave residue. I like that it is mainly unscented and I could see myself using this during the winter. I highly recommend and will be continuing to use this.

I've been using the Centella Hyalu Cica Moisture Cream and I'm honestly obsessed. The texture is lightweight but still super nourishing, and it sinks into my skin without feeling greasy. My skin feels so soft after applying it, almost bouncy, and it gives me that calm, hydrated look all day. The centella + hyaluronic combo really soothes any irritation while keeping my face moisturized. If you need a gentle cream that actually delivers on softness and hydration, this one is definitely worth it.
The product is very loose. As soon as you squeeze the bottle a ton of product comes out . Feels very light on the skin but is probably better for use in the summer not winter

I really love this product, my skin feels hydrated after applying this product, it also makes my skin feel soft and supple. It has all the natural ingredients which makes me feels safe. I love to use this everyday as part of my daily routine

I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review. I've been using this cream for a week now and I just don't think it's a good fit for me. We're in the cold winter months now and while my skin is dry because of it, I think the cream is a bit too lightweight to really help me at this time. The fragrance is light which I appreciate and I will absolutely be giving it another go after winter.

avis.titre: Don't be fooled by the light texture!
avis.texte: I received this product as part of a free sample program. When I first felt the texture, I thought that there was no way it would keep me from drying out. It's somewhere between a gel and cream which is new to me. For reference, I have dry to normal skin and at the time I was using this, it was 40-50 degrees F (4.4-5 C) and around 60% humidity. Normally, I'm flaking around my nose and mouth by the end of the day but I didn't have that problem with this. However, once the temperature dropped to 30 degrees F (-1 C) I needed something heavier. Overall, it worked well with my makeup and I'm impressed with how moisturized this kept my skin given the thin and light texture!
I love this Hyalu Cica line; it's lightweight and absorbs really well. I also use it with their sunscreen, and I love how hydrated my skin looks during the day. It's ideal for my sensitive skin.

I received this moisturizer for free through the BzzAgent program. I've been using it for a bit now and really like how lightweight it feels while still giving my skin deep hydration. It sinks in fast, doesn't leave any greasy residue, and keeps my face looking calm and balanced throughout the day

I received Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Moisture Cream for free in exchange for my honest opinion. I have been using this moisturizer cream for a little over a week now after I wash my face. There isn't much of scent which is a good thing to me. It is slightly a greasy feel at first but as the cream sets in it does pretty well at moisturizing my face. I highly recommend.

I've been using the Hyalu-Cica Moisture Cream and honestly, it's such a nice moisturizer. It's super lightweight but still gives my skin a really good amount of hydration. I feel like I can use it all year, but it's especially perfect for summer because it sinks in fast and leaves a nice matte finish. Before I used other moisturizing creams which did not made my skin that much hydrated and they even irritated my skin. Since I tried the Hyalu-Cica Moisture Cream I will never go back to other brands. I will also recommend it to my friends and family. My skin has been looking better since I started using it, and even a couple of my pimples went away after sticking with it.I have been using it both, in the morning and before going to bed. In the morning for me this cream is a perfect base for my makeup, which keeps my skin moisturized. At night it's put moisture on my skin and its feels really nice in the morning. Overall, it's just a really solid, comfy everyday cream that works well for my skin.

avis.titre: Great for Humid Weather, Just a Bit Light for Winter
avis.texte: I've been using this cream with my oily-combination skin in a really humid climate, and overall I'm impressed. It absorbs quickly without leaving any grease, and it keeps my skin calm and balanced throughout the day. The only reason I'm giving it 4 stars is because it's just a bit too light for winter, my face starts to feel a little tight when the air gets dry. If it were a touch more moisturizing during colder months, it'd be perfect. Still, for everyday use in warm, humid weather, it's a great option.

I received this product in return for my honest feedback. I love this moisturizer. I have been looking for one that wasn't too heavy and didn't break me out, and this is it. I would repurchase over and over again. It is light, smells nice, and moisturizes my skin all day.

Really loving this cream so far! It feels super lightweight but still gives my skin a nice hydrated, plump look. No sticky finish, absorbs fast, and the centella makes my skin calm when it's irritated. Perfect for daily use, especially if you want moisture without heaviness.
I put this product on after cleansing night and day and usually for a boost of moisture before applying my makeup. It's super light weight and goes on really nicely!

The only reason I didn't give this 5 stars is the fragrance. It's not super strong and it goes away after application but it's still a little overwhelming. I use this every morning after washing my face and I like the application feel. It's a nice lighter feeling moisturizer. I'm interested to see how well it works as the winter progresses.

I received this product in exchange for an honest review. The Skin1004 SPF is a favorite of mine, so I had high hopes for this moisturizer and it did not disappoint. It made my skin feel plump and wasn't overly sticky/tacky, and layered great under my makeup. I have very sensitive skin and this didn't cause any breakouts or adverse reactions on my face. I've been using it primarily in the daytime but feel that it work well as an overnight moisturizer too (will trial it at night once my nighttime moisturizer runs out). The price point is also great in a landscape of moisturizers that are $50+. I go through moisturizer like crazy, so not having to cough up $$$ every month is a huge benefit for me.

I have been using this moisturizer for a week and so far no issues with my sensitive skin! I don't particularly find it as calming as other centella products, but it is still pleasing to use. It isn't heavy and layers well over other moisturizers and sunscreen. It does have some fragrance in it if you are sensitive to smells. I will continue to use this product as a daily moisturizer. *Product received as a part of a free sample program but all views are my own.
This is a hydrating moisturizer. Nice consistency, doesn't leave a residue.

avis.titre: Decently moisturizing but broke me out
avis.texte: Received a free sample through BzzAgent and was fine on my skin the first night. However I started breaking out afterwards. I didn't change my skincare, just this so it has to be the cream.

I received this product in a sample program and was not expecting much because of the price being so reasonable. I usually use very expensive products, but still haven't found a moisturizer that actually hydrates my skin long-term. The ingredients in this product plump, hydrate, and hold moisture like no other product I have used. My skin looks incredible and my coworkers have asked me what I'm using. I went from dry, flaky skin to beautiful, moisturized skin that looks like I just left a facial. I will absolutely buy this product again when I run out. This product proves that a high price doesn't mean anything - you can spend less and get a much better result with this! I love it!

Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Moisture Cream feels incredibly soothing and lightweight on the skin. It provides deep hydration without any greasiness, making it perfect for daily use. My skin feels calmer, softer, and visibly refreshed after each application.
I absolutely love this product it feels and smells good with not too much h perfume goes on smooth leaves a great feeling
I love this product, I've used it several times and it leaves my hair amazing. I highly recommend it.

avis.titre: Hydration That Feels Like a Hug
avis.texte: I'm obsessed with how lightweight yet deeply hydrating this cream is! It sinks in instantly, leaves my skin soft and plump, and even calms any redness. Perfect for daily use, and it doesn't feel greasy at all. My skin just feels happy and refreshed every time I use it.

This was my first time trying the Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Moisture Cream, and I was genuinely impressed with how well it works. I have combination skin, so rich moisturizers often leave me looking greasy and sometimes even cause breakouts. This one didn't do that at all. It gives a healthy glow without the shine, and my skin feels soft, hydrated, and comfortable throughout the day. I've been using it both in the morning and at night, and it performs beautifully in both routines. There's no scent, which I love, especially for something I apply so often. Overall, it's a moisturizer I would absolutely continue using and confidently recommend to others.
i love this moisturizer and i recommend it to everyone!! it's perfect for combo skin and leaves the skin feeling so hydrated
Use as the last step in your skin care routine, deeply moisturizes and penetrates my eczema prone skin! Loving it!

avis.titre: Tingling and burning of the skin with strong cherry fragranc
avis.texte: I have an overall sensitive skin. When purchasing I go for items usually with little to no fragrance but when trying I noticed a strong artificial cherry scent for the moisturizer. When applied to the skin I'm left with a burning tightening feeling

This product was honestly kind of disappointing. I really tried to love it. I was using it for a while as well. As someone with combo/sensitive skin, I feel like it didn't do anything for me. I feel like my skin looked the same and I got no results from it. Personally, I like my mositurizers to be thicker for extra hydration. This one did not hydrate the way I wanted it to. I say skip this one and go for other ones.

avis.titre: I'm really liking this so far
avis.texte: I got this as a free sample and so far im really liking it! The first time i used it I was really surprised by the texture. Im used to really heavy creams but this is nice and light. It makes my face sooo soft! Definitely notice it doesnt absorb as well into the skin if i havent exfoliated my face in a week though, but thats the case w most moisturizers.
hydrates but doesnt leave a sticky thick feeling on the face. great for my dry-combo skin that is sensitive
This definitely makes my skin feel hydrated. Its light and slightly watery. Makes my skin burn every so often but that might just be because my skin gets dry easily.
Amazing, keeps my face so soft and absorbs really nice. Nice light natural fragrance that disappears.

avis.titre: I am not sure who can use this
avis.texte: I have very dry mature skin. I also live in a very dry environment (less than 20 percent humidity is the average) and yet this "moisturizer" just sits on my skin and does not absorb. Even face oils nearly instantly absorb into my skin, but this, sits on my skin and looks and feels like sweat on in a hunid environment. I have red reactive skin, and my redness with this product is worse when I use it. Even my color corrector that usually makes me look like a ghost cannot cancel out the redness in my skin after I use this product. I can honestly so this product is not for dry skin and given it does not absorb into the skin I would not recommend it for oily or combo skin. I even tried using this product on other parts of my body that was dry, again no absorbtion, even after 20 minutes. save your money because this is hands down the worst moisturizer I ever tried.

avis.titre: I look like a beautiful glazed donut!
avis.texte: When I bought this moisturizer, I didn't know anything about the product or the main ingredient, centella. I have been pleasantly surprised and impressed with it! The formula is lightweight, cooling, and soaks right into the skin leaving a soft glow and smooth to the touch texture. My skin has felt bouncier and more hydrated with continuous use. I have combination skin, which is works beautifully with but if you lean towards the dryer side, it may not be heavy enough. *side note - it comes out FAST! Squeeze it slow unless you plan on sharing it.
My skin is super soft after using this. I use it as a moisturizer after applying sunscreen. Its keeps my face hydrated throughout the day.

My skin has been having some uncomfortable, unsightly patches of flaking and redness. I have tried at least ten different moisturizers and nothing helped with the redness or flaky patches. I had received this product as a free step-up gift a while back and gave it a try. I experienced zero burning (yes!) and no redness. I did still have some flaky dry skin areas. After three days, the patchy dry areas are totally gone. I came here to purchase a tube, and the price point is so much less than anything I've used.
I received this as a deluxe sample. It works very well on my face.

it's not rich enough to be a facial moisturizer (just a preference) but it's perfect for arms and legs where I have KP. It made my bumps reduce A LOT and my skin is so soft. It absorbs so fast and no sticky residue is left. It doesn't claim to help with KP or be a body lotion but this is what I use it for and it's amazing. Will be purchasing more.
This moisture cream is very nice but the bottle is haft empty

I received this item as a deluxe sample for spending over a certain amount along with the syrum. I LOVE THEM! my skin feels baby soft and I've been having such amazing skin days. I'm not sure what the labels say but the products are so good. I'll be purchasing them from now on.

I have dry skin with rosacea. My old moisturizer has been good to me for years but lately it hasn't been as effective as it used to be so decided to try something new. I was on the fence between skin1004 and another brand. The skin1004 brand has been popular with more reviews, so in the end, i decided to try this hyalu-cica moisture cream. It was lightweight, had a slight fragrance, and applied easily on the face. Perhaps it was too lightweight though, that i felt it wasnt absorbing properly. I tried this for roughly 3 months. The first month, i noticed that it wasnt as hydrating as my last moisturizer, but i assumed it was because i was changing things up. Second month rolled along and my face was getting dry. At that point, I thought maybe theres something in this that wasnt reacting well with my other skin care routine (just a cleanser and serum) so i decided to test things out and removed everything but this moisturizer for a month. The result was kinda surprising. My face have never been so dry before. I was getting patches of flaky skin on my face. My rosacea flared up more aggressively than usual. For a moisturizer that was suppose to be hydrating and calming that can lasts up to 100 hours, i had to moisturize every 2-3 hours, and even then, i wake up dryer than the day before. It was crazy. So yeah, definitely not for me. It did not do what it said it was supposed to do. I went back to my old moisturizer and it kinda fixed the problem but like I said in the beginning,
Really irritated my skun. I think its the level of niacinamide in it

I absolutely love this oil cleanser! It doesn't irritate my skin and it's very effective at removing makeup especially masacra! I use this in my first step in double cleansing and after I wash the second time I have no residue.

This moisturizer is asolutely worthless. I'm not even going to call this a moisturizer because it is not. Maybe it's more suitable for people with normal to oily skin. My skin is super dry. It did absolutely nothing for me. This is a lightweight moisturizer so if you're super dry like me, do not buy this.

avis.titre: Good product just not for me
avis.texte: Good moisturizer, nice texture and consistency but unfortunately didnt work out with my sensitive skin, aleays stung when i applied but then sting would calm down over time. Sad because alot of people rave about this brand and this moisturizer!
My skin loves this stuff. My face feels moisturized without feeling oily/balmy. It drinks it right up. No nausiating heavy scents. I will be purchasing this again.

WOW. I have extremely sensitive skin, like even applying something to my face makes it red, even water makes it red. Ive tried TONS of moisturizers, i saw this in stores and decided to swithc it up because it has clean ingredients, alcohol and fragrance free. And holy moly im never going back. I applied this and instantly my moisturizer barrier was improved. It caused no redness or itching while applying which is so rare for me to find. It feels light but very reparing and looks great on the skin, please try it and if it doesnt work you can return it, but its so worth it for everyone and im so grateful i found this product
Really love this moisturizer and so glad I tried it. I have dry skin and it absorbs into the skin really nicely which makes it perfect if you're looking for a good moisturizer to wear under makeup.

I'm currently going through chemotherapy. That has caused my skin to be extremely sensitive and dry on a level I did not know was possible. This product is not irritating and doesn't seem to have fragrance. However, it is not moisturizing enough. I have been using this for two months and see no improvements in my skin. I did have to add a facial oil and hyalauronic acid serum so my face wouldn't dry out. For the price, this would be great for someone with sensitive skin but doesn't have issues with excessively dry skin. If I weren't going through chemo, I might buy again.
I have very dry skin and this does a amazing job at moisturizing, I do add a cicaplast balm on top of it for extra moisture but it is amazing on its own too!

I have combination skin and this provides the perfect amount of moisture for my skin even in the winter time. It absorbs so quickly into the skin. I do set it with powder and stays oil free all day. Highly recommend!

This moisturizer gives me wonderful hydration and i wake up with shiny smooth skin. It works well with all my serums, no skin burning, and leaves me feeling fresh. 10/10 i keep it in my skin care fridge and i love the way it feels when i put it on. It definitely cools my face when i feel flushed. My only tiny tiny tiny complaint is that a lot come out with little pressure. I often put too much in my hand.

I received this as a free product and found the texture of this face cream was smooth and it moisturized great. The scent is very mild and the packaging is great for travel. Overall this moisturizer is successful.

avis.titre: Light weight and good for normal skin type
avis.texte: The SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Soothing Cream is the perfect final step in my skincare routine. It hydrates my skin deeply, leaving it soft and glowing without any sticky residue. The texture is lightweight yet nourishing, and it absorbs quickly, making it ideal for both day and night use. The soothing properties of Centella Asiatica calm any irritation, and my skin feels balanced and refreshed after applying. The packaging is simple and hygienic, and the citrus scent is subtle but refreshing. This cream is a must for anyone looking for hydration and calmness in one product!
I really love this sunscreen because it doesn't make my eyes sting when i apply it too close, which a lot of other sunscreens do. It also absorbs into the skin quickly.

You use this lotion last in your skin routine. It doesn't have a smell it spreads flawlessly all over your face and leaves your skin feeling clean and not sticky. The tube is really big and works great. Definitely try.

Very nice minimalistic packaging, overall nice cream. I really like that it doesn't contain any harsh ingredients like parabens or sulfates. But for me it wasn't the right hydration level. I love when my skin feels super moisturized but this cream didn't left my skin as hydrated as i wanted.
Beautiful moisturized skin! I love this product specifically after I put on all of my skin oils/retinol. It gives a nice glow and the moisture lasts all day. Totally recommend.

Absolutely love! I was shocked by how good it made my skin look literally immediately. The redness disappeared and my pores seemed smaller. My new step before make up! Works well alone too! Complimentary gift.
I really like how light this product is. It has no smell, and it's very gentle. I am getting older, and my skin is changing, but I feel like this is so gentle I could definitely use this everyday
Out of the set, this is a good soothing cream! The scent is a nice light vanilla and it feels good on my skin. I didn't notice a major difference using it but if you want a light cream this is it!

I did receive this lotion for free for a review. This lotion is nice and light weight. It will be perfect for the summer and when the weather gets warmer. It's soothing on my skin which is sensitive and requires gentle ingredients.

I received this proudct in exchange for my honest review. I wasn't expecting this cream to be such a light gel texture, but I love it! It feels cooling and soothing on my skin and sinks in so quickly, locking in hydration without any greasiness. It's perfect for layering, and my skin feels plump and hydrated. This one's a keeper for sure!
I really love the texture of this moisturizer. Very calming scent and makes my skin feel very soft. Nice thin packaging so I can put in my skincare bag.

this cream is extremely lightweight, it does not have a lingering scent, the ingredients are minimal which make it great for any skin type. it provides deep hydration, and the packaging is simple but looks modern.
It's gel texture which surprised me but it still felt kinda heavy to me, which surprised me even more my skin feels soft and has a healthy glow. Overall I like it a lot
It felt soft and smelled amazing. Loved the package it came in. The effects it left on my skin was amazing, left feeling soft and not sticky. Highly recommend. it was given free by influncer!

I was surprised when I squeezed this stuff out of the container it wasn't white or clear but almost a tan color. It goes on very lightly and feels almost like a gel feeling. A little goes a long way so this could last you a while too.

I wanted to love this but it's just ok. I have sensitive skin and it did not irritate it at all. It smells really nice; like plum. It goes on light but leaves a sticky feeling. I don't really feel like it does anything great for my skin.

I have dry skin so I always try to find hydrating products. This product did absorb quickly. I had to keep rubbing for over a minute for it to be able absorb onto my skin. I tried it with my skin dry and damp, neither worked. Makes my skin feel greasy.
Thise lotion has a great texture and provides good hydration. I am happy I stumbled across it. This is my face lotion for days off. Its perfect under sundcreen as well. Will buy again.

avis.titre: Great moisturizer for dry and sensitive skin
avis.texte: My skin is mildy sensitive and I get dry, flaky patches around my chin and mouth area. This moisturizer has greatly reduced it and is now my daily moisturizer. It does have a scent, but I don't think it's too overpowering.

As a freelancer for several prestige skin care brands in ulta, and an esthetician of over 20 years, i can confidently say this brand is as good if not better than some of the more expensive ones. I have combo skin, oily in the t zone, and this sinks into skin leaving it perfectly moisturized, feeling bouncy, and hydrated. I think all skin types can use it but it truly depends on someones skin care routine for how it will aborb/sit on the skin. I will be repurchasing.

avis.titre: Please sell the sunscreen!! You will make bank
